1000000019.Text: Gandalf tells Bilbo the ancient history of the ring, implying that it is not just a magic ring, but the "One Ring." The making of Sauron's ring, the War of the Ring, and the events following the loss of the ring are summarized. The reader realizes for the first time the significance of the ring.

1000000020.Text: Gandalf tells the story of Smeagol (Gollum) and how the ring ruined his life. It describes how Smeagol found the ring, how it corrupted him, and what happened to his life after losing it. The cursed nature of the ring is emphasized in this section.

1000000021.Text: Gandalf explains that Sauron is resurrected and his power is growing stronger. Word comes that the Burning Tower of Mordor and Sauron's Watchtowers are active again, and the threat of the Nazgûl looms large. Sauron's desperate attempt to recover the Ring is revealed.

1000000022.Text: Gandalf confirms through the experiment of the ring (throwing it into a fire and seeing the pattern that appears) that Bilbo's ring is the One Ring. This discovery shocks Frodo greatly, and he realizes how deeply the ring is connected to his destiny.

1000000023.Text: Frodo must listen to Gandalf's explanation and make a decision to keep the ring or leave. He does not want to leave the Shire, but feels compelled to take the ring because of the threat of Sauron. His initial hesitation and ultimate decision are described.

1000000024.Text: Strider (Aragorn) leads the Fellowship of the Ring into the darkness and explains the threat of the Nazgûl. Their journey becomes more and more dangerous, and the memories of the safety and peace of the Shire are described as fading away.

1000000025.Text: As the Nazgûl draw nearer, the Fellowship begins to sense their presence. Thick fog and strange whispers appear, heightening the sense of unease and fear. This subtitle emphasizes the oppression and fear of the Nazgûl’s presence.

1000000026.Text: The expedition takes a breather at the "Dancing Pony Inn" in Bree with Strider, but even there they realize that they are not safe. The possibility of a Nazgûl attack is growing, and there is growing anxiety that an unknown traitor could be leaking information.

1000000027.Text: The Nazgûl begin their attack in earnest. The action of the Nazgûl is described as attacking the wrong location instead of the inn room, and the Fellowship barely manages to escape with their lives. Strider's fighting prowess and determination are highlighted, and they realize that their journey can no longer be peaceful.

1000000028.Text: Strider warns the Fellowship that they cannot continue on this path, and decides to head to Rivendell. They move quickly and prepare for another attack by the Nazgûl. Despite the hopelessness of the situation, Frodo and his companions try to hold on to a small spark of hope.

1000000029.Text: The expedition passes through the Elven Forest and arrives at the entrance to the Mines of Moria, the ancient kingdom of the Dwarves. In the process of finding the way, they discover an ancient gate and use the wisdom of Galadriel and Gandalf to open it. As they open the gate, they sense an unknown presence in the darkness targeting them.

1000000030.Text: The expedition enters the mines and explores the ruins and silence left behind by the dwarves long ago. It is a place steeped in history and tragedy, and Gandalf tells of the mines’ downfall and the horrors that reigned there. The atmosphere becomes increasingly heavy, and every sound begins to feel menacing.

1000000031.Text: The expedition passes through the ruins of the dwarven kingdom, discovering weapons and ornaments they left behind. Along the way, they discuss their past glory and the greed and arrogance that led to their downfall. However, tensions rise as they sense something moving during their exploration.

1000000032.Text: Deep within Moria, a mysterious entity begins to pursue the Fellowship. Footsteps and whispers are heard, and eyes are seen shining in the darkness where no light can reach. Gandalf warns that this entity may not be a simple pursuer, but a servant of the "Balrog".

1000000033.Text: The expedition almost falls into a trap while trying to cross a collapsed bridge. They narrowly escape with their lives, clashing with creatures such as trolls and goblins. Their desperate escape and Gandalf's magic are emphasized, implying that the darkness of the mine is not simply physical darkness, but a terror that tests their minds.

1010100100.Text:
Ada and the protagonist quell the disturbance that occurred at the Talt Research Camp.
In front of an ancient ruin's device that even Ada could not handle, the protagonist hears a mysterious voice.
Feeling a sense of familiarity, the protagonist touches the device. And they confirm that the ancient ruin reactivates, as if it had been waiting for the protagonist for a long time.
At that moment, the protagonist also has a premonition of the path they must take.

11002000901.Text: Negotiation, you know... isn't that easy.

11002000902.Text: (After a long time of training.) Your training attitude is really good. This is enough.

11002000903.Text: There are 770,000 constellations in the sky.

11002000904.Text: They say delicious food comes from the heart.

11002000905.Text: Sometimes I miss my mom’s cooking…

11002000906.Text: I can't even do this anymore. Sometimes knowing too much can be stressful.

11002000907.Text: You too, stop now... and rest comfortably.

11002001107.Text: 탈것에 대해 궁금한 모양이군. 탈것을 사용하기 위해서는 여러 단계가 필요하지.

11002001108.Text: 첫번째, 탈것 아이템이 필요해. 탈것 아이템을 우클릭 사용해서 탈것을 획득하지.

11002001109.Text: 두번째, 탈것 관리인을 찾아가 사용할 탈것을 등록해야 하네. 마을마다 나와 같은 일을 하는 '탈것 관리인' 들이 존재하네.

11002001110.Text: 세번째, 링커맨드에 Action 메뉴에 있는 Mount를 등록해야 하네.

11002001111.Text: 마지막으로 링커맨드 단축키 C를 눌러 등록한 탈것 스킬을 사용할 수 있다네.

11201000501.Text: 무역상은 아무나 하는게 아니라구요. 잠깐만, 시간되시면 제 부탁좀 들어주세요.

11201000741.Text: 이 마을은 우리 모두의 노력으로 유지되지. 자네의 작은 기부가 우리 모두의 삶에 큰 도움이 될 걸세.

11201000751.Text: 당신이 가지고 있는 물건의 진짜 가치를 찾고 싶나요? 제가 운영하는 거래소에서라면 합당한 가격을 받을 수 있을 거예요.

11201000761.Text: 어서 와요, 어센더님! 힘든 여정에 지쳤다면 제 여관에서 푹 쉬고 가세요! 따뜻한 방과 맛있는 음식, 그리고 좋은 동료를 만나게 해줄 수도 있답니다.

11201000771.Text: 모험가님의 소지품은 제가 안전하게 보관해드리죠. 창고에 있는 물건은 모두 기억하고 있으니 걱정말아요.

11201000781.Text: 탈것은 모험가의 생명줄이지. 이 녀석들의 상태를 완벽하게 점검하는 것이 바로 내 임무라네.

11201000791.Text: 나는 묵직한 망치를 휘둘러 금속을 다루지. 튼튼한 무기가 필요하다면 자네의 금광석을 가져와 보게.

11201000801.Text: 나는 나무를 다듬어 세상을 짓지. 자네가 베어온 나무만 있다면, 어떤 것이든 만들 수 있지.

11201000811.Text: 나는 약초의 순수한 힘만을 담아내지. 약초의 순도를 높이는 일은 노력과 지식이 필요한 일이라네.

11201000821.Text: 요리는 사랑과 열정으로 만드는 거야! 새로운 재료를 가져와 준다면, 내가 세상에서 제일 맛있는 요리를 만들줄게.

11201000831.Text: 나는 돌 속에 숨겨진 아름다움을 찾아내지. 보석 원석은 그 자체로 예술이 될 수 있어.

11201000841.Text: 나는 가죽을 다루지. 거친 가죽을 부드러운 가죽으로 만드는 일은 나에게 맡겨주게.

11201000851.Text: 나는 마법 재료로 세상을 바꿀 수 있어. 운명을 바꾸고 싶다면, 그런 물약을 만들 수도 있다고...

11201000861.Text: 나는 무기에 혼을 불어넣지. 강인함이 담긴 재료를 가져온다면, 전설의 무기를 만들어주겠네.

11201000871.Text: 방어구는 생명을 지키는 것이다. 나는 단단한 금속으로 자네의 생명을 지켜주겠네.

11201000881.Text: 나는 아름다움을 빚어내지. 마법적인 아름다움을 지닌 장신구를 만든다면 나에게 맡겨줘.

11201000891.Text: 나는 보석의 영혼을 깎아내지. 자네가 가져온 보석을 다듬어 빛을 내게 해줄 수 있지.

11201000901.Text: 나는 탈것을 길들이는 일에 평생을 바쳤지.

11201000911.Text: 상처받은 자들을 치유하는 약을 만들어줄 수 있어.

11201000921.Text: 이 가게에 없는 물건은 아마 세상에도 없을 걸?

11201000931.Text: 나는 자네의 잠재력을 끌어내 줄 무언가를 만들어 줄 수 있다네.

11201000941.Text: 최근들어 무허가로 게이트를 탐험하는 자들이 늘어나고 있어! 이렇게 협회가 존재하고 있는데...

11201000951.Text: 대장님이 너무하긴 했어요. 아직 어린 아이를 그렇게 혼내시다니..

12000010013.Text: 균열에 잠식된 고위 마족 무리 처치

13000020001.Text: My legs are giving out... I can't go on... Don't... don't leave me alone!

13000020002.Text: Did you hear that? Just now... It was definitely not the wind... There was another sound! Ha... Ha ha... I must be losing my mind…

13000020003.Text: This garden... isn't abandoned... it's like... the nest of something... What is this cold, seeping energy...?
